# UX Checklist: Base de telas (screen-base)

**Purpose**: Validar a qualidade dos requisitos de interface da 003 (nomes de tela, aba e subtela no painel, "Unknown
screen" e "Unknown tab", situações fora dos menus, nada a preencher) antes do plano
**Created**: 2026-11-08
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Depth: Standard · Audience: Reviewer (PR)

## Nomes no painel

- [x] CHK001 Is "de forma simples" defined by what the panel shows and where? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019]
- [x] CHK002 Are the order and the separator of window, tab and subscreen specified? [Clarity, Spec §US2, §FR-006, §FR-019]
- [x] CHK003 Is every fixed text of the panel given literally? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §FR-006, §FR-016, §US3]
- [x] CHK004 Is the update time of about 1 s consistent between the story and the success criterion? [Consistency, Spec §US1, §SC-006]
- [x] CHK005 Is the text defined for when no window is open? [Gap, Spec §FR-019]

## Unknown screen e Unknown tab

- [x] CHK006 Is the fallback for a window without proof specified as an exact text? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK007 Is the fallback for a tab without a confirmed name in a known window specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK008 Is the fallback for a subscreen without a confirmed name specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK009 Is it clear that "Unknown tab" applies only inside a known window? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK010 Is the text defined for a map or monster number that a readable table does not have? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK011 Is it specified that a tab never carries over from the window closed before? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, §SC-003]

## Situações fora dos menus

- [x] CHK012 Are the texts of character select, AFK Gains and being inside a cave specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010, §US3]
- [x] CHK013 Is the cave identified with its window closed, under the same proof rule as any other name? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, §FR-009]
- [x] CHK014 Is it defined which name wins when two states match at once, such as a window open inside a cave? [Gap, Spec §Open Questions]
- [x] CHK015 Are the states the reader cannot detect (NPC dialogue, loading, login) defined as normal play? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, §Out of Scope]
- [x] CHK016 Are the windows of other classes, not seen in the round, covered by the fallback? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §Assumptions]

## Nada a preencher

- [x] CHK017 Is what leaves the interface with "Name it" listed item by item? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [x] CHK018 Is "campo" clear about whether the Settings checkboxes count? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK019 Can the absence of fields be checked objectively? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004, §US4]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- CHK001, CHK005, CHK008, CHK010 e CHK018: respondidos por padrões do agente (Open Questions).
- CHK014: fica para o plano (Open Questions, `to plan`).
